laws.title: Constitution of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh
laws.bangla_title: গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশের সংবিধান (মৌলিক অধিকার ও রিট এক্তিয়ার)
laws.simple_summary: The Constitution is the supreme law of Bangladesh. Any law inconsistent with the fundamental rights guaranteed under Part III is void. Article 102 empowers the High Court Division to issue prerogative writs (Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Certiorari, Prohibition, Quo-Warranto) to enforce fundamental human rights and check administrative overreach.
laws.simple_summary_bn: গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশের সংবিধান হলো দেশের সর্বোচ্চ আইন। সংবিধানের তৃতীয় ভাগে বর্ণিত নাগরিকদের মৌলিক অধিকারের সাথে অসামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ যেকোনো আইন বাতিল হবে। অনুচ্ছেদ ১০২ এর অধীন হাইকোর্ট বিভাগ নাগরিকদের অধিকার রক্ষা ও বেআইনি পদক্ষেপ প্রতিরোধে হেবিয়াস কর্পাস, ম্যানডামাসসহ ৫ ধরণের রিট আদেশ জারি করতে পারে।
key_provisions: Article 27: Equality before law and equal protection of law for all citizens.
Article 31: Absolute right to be treated in accordance with law and only in accordance with law.
Article 32: Protection of right to life and personal liberty; no deprivation save in accordance with law.
Article 35: Protection in respect of trial and punishment; prohibition of torture and cruel punishment.
Article 102: Writ jurisdiction of the High Court Division for direct enforcement of fundamental rights.

procedure_steps.title: Notice of Demand for Justice
procedure_steps.desc: Advocate serves statutory legal notice of demand for justice to government authorities granting 48 hours to 7 days time to rectify unlawful decision.

procedure_steps.title: Draft Writ Petition under Art 102
procedure_steps.desc: Counsel drafts comprehensive writ petition detailing statutory violation, lack of jurisdiction, or breach of natural justice.

procedure_steps.title: Motion Hearing in High Court Bench
procedure_steps.desc: Argue motion before designated High Court Division Writ Bench for issuance of Rule Nisi and interim stay order.

procedure_steps.title: Service of Rule Nisi
procedure_steps.desc: Serve court notice and injunction orders upon government respondents.

procedure_steps.title: Final Hearing & Judgment
procedure_steps.desc: Court makes Rule Nisi absolute, quashing illegal administrative orders or ordering release of illegally detained persons.

laws.penalties: Any government official acting in defiance of High Court writ orders faces direct Contempt of Court proceedings, fine, and civil imprisonment.
laws.penalties_bn: উচ্চ আদালতের রিট আদেশ অমান্যকারী যেকোনো সরকারি কর্মকর্তা সরাসরি আদালত অবমাননার (Contempt of Court) দায়ে জরিমানা ও কারাদণ্ডে দণ্ডিত হতে পারেন।
required_documents: Impugned government order, notification, or memo copy
National ID card (NID) copy of the petitioner
Certified proof of violation of fundamental right or administrative illegality
Proof of service of Demand for Justice notice
immediate_actions: Engage an enrolled Advocate of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh immediately upon receipt of unlawful government decision.
Ensure certified copy of the challenged circular, notice, or order is procured without delay.

laws.title: Land Ownership, Khatian Records & Illegal Encroachment
laws.bangla_title: জমির মালিকানা, খতিয়ান রেকর্ড ও অবৈধ দখল উচ্ছেদ আইন
acts: Land Crime Prevention and Redress Act, 2023 (Sections 4, 5, 7, 8)
laws.simple_summary: Under the Land Crime Prevention and Redress Act 2023, forging title deeds, fabricating duplicate registration deeds, and forceful illegal land grabbing are now severe non-bailable criminal offences punishable by rigorous imprisonment up to 7 years. Genuine ownership requires a chain of deeds (Baya Dalil), updated mutation (Namjari), Khatian (CS, SA, RS, BS), and current land tax (Khajna) receipts.
laws.simple_summary_bn: ভূমি অপরাধ প্রতিরোধ ও প্রতিকার আইন ২০২৩ অনুযায়ী জাল দলিল তৈরি, প্রতারণামূলকভাবে একই জমি একাধিক ব্যক্তির কাছে বিক্রি এবং জোরপূর্বক জমি দখল করা জামিন-অযোগ্য ফৌজদারি অপরাধ, যার সর্বোচ্চ শাস্তি ৭ বছরের সশ্রম কারাদণ্ড ও অর্থদণ্ড। বৈধ মালিকানার জন্য মূল দলিল, বায়া দলিল, নামজারি খতিয়ান ও খাজনার দাখিলা থাকা আবশ্যক।
key_provisions: Section 4: Forgery of land ownership deeds punishable with rigorous imprisonment up to 7 years.
Section 7: Forcefully grabbing or dispossessing legal owner is a cognizable and non-bailable criminal offence.
Section 8: Creating duplicate title deeds to defraud co-sharers or buyers carries up to 5 years jail.
Section 9 Specific Relief Act: Summary civil suit within 6 months of wrongful dispossession to regain possession without proving title.
Section 145 CrPC: Executive Magistrate intervention to prevent bloodshed or breach of peace on disputed land.

procedure_steps.title: Verify Records at AC Land Office
procedure_steps.desc: Verify Mutation Khatian, DCR, and verify RS/BS record matches ground physical possession.

procedure_steps.title: File Sec 144/145 CrPC if Threatened
procedure_steps.desc: If rival party threatens violent dispossession, move Executive Magistrate Court for restraining order.

procedure_steps.title: Lodge Case under Land Crime Act 2023
procedure_steps.desc: File criminal complaint with police or Magistrate Court for forged documents or land grabbing.

procedure_steps.title: File Title Suit / Injunction in Civil Court
procedure_steps.desc: File civil suit for declaration of title and permanent injunction against encroachment in Joint District Judge Court.

procedure_steps.title: Execution of Possession Decree
procedure_steps.desc: Execute decree with court bailiff and police assistance if necessary.

laws.penalties: Rigorous imprisonment up to 7 years, hefty financial penalties, and immediate summary eviction of illegal occupants by Executive Magistrate.
laws.penalties_bn: সর্বোচ্চ ৭ বছরের সশ্রম কারাদণ্ড, অর্থদণ্ড এবং নির্বাহী ম্যাজিস্ট্রেট কর্তৃক দখলদারকে উচ্ছেদ করে প্রকৃত মালিকের কাছে দখল হস্তান্তরের বিধান।
required_documents: Original registered Sale Deed (মূল কবলা দলিল) and previous chain deeds (বায়া দলিল)
Latest Mutation Khatian (নামজারি খতিয়ান) and DCR receipt
Up-to-date Land Development Tax receipt (দাখিলা / খাজনার রশিদ)
CS, SA, RS, BS Khatian certified copies from District Record Room (কালেক্টরেট রেকর্ড রুম)
Field survey map / Mouza map and boundary demarcation sketch
immediate_actions: Never leave vacant land unfenced; construct boundary wall and install name board with deed and mutation numbers.
Pay land development tax online annually through the Bangladesh Land Ministry portal (land.gov.bd).
Obtain Non-Encumbrance Certificate (NEC) from Sub-Registry office before purchasing any land.

laws.title: Cheque Dishonour, Bounced Cheques & Financial Recovery
laws.bangla_title: চেক ডিজঅনার, চেক বাউন্স ও টাকা আদায়ের মামলা (১৮৮১ সালের ১৩৮ ধারা)
laws.simple_summary: When a bank cheque bounces due to insufficient funds or account closure, the holder can file a criminal case under Section 138 of the NI Act. This law has extremely strict, non-extendable statutory limitation deadlines: you must present the cheque within 6 months, obtain bank memo, serve legal notice within 30 days, give 30 days time to pay, and file case in court within 30 days thereafter.
laws.simple_summary_bn: ব্যাংক একাউন্টে পর্যাপ্ত টাকা না থাকার কারণে চেক প্রত্যাখ্যাত (বাউন্স) হলে হস্তান্তরযোগ্য দলিল আইনের ১৩৮ ধারায় ফৌজদারি মামলা দায়ের করা যায়। এই আইনের সময়সীমা অত্যন্ত কঠোর: চেক ফেরত পাওয়ার ৩০ দিনের মধ্যে লিগ্যাল নোটিশ পাঠাতে হবে, নোটিশ পাওয়ার পর ৩০ দিন সময় দিতে হবে এবং টাকা না দিলে পরবর্তী ৩০ দিনের মধ্যে আদালতে মামলা দায়ের করতে হবে।
key_provisions: Cheque must be presented within its validity period (6 months from date of issue).
Statutory Advocate Legal Notice must be sent within 30 days from receiving Bank Cheque Return Memo.
Drawer has 30 days from receipt of notice to make full payment.
Complaint (CR Case) must be filed within 30 days after the expiry of the 30-day notice period before Chief Metropolitan / Chief Judicial Magistrate.
Section 138 allows court to award twice the cheque amount to the complainant.

procedure_steps.title: Bank Return Memo
procedure_steps.desc: Present cheque to bank and obtain official "Cheque Return Memo" stating dishonour reason (e.g. Insufficient Funds).

procedure_steps.title: Serve Statutory Legal Notice
procedure_steps.desc: Through an Advocate, send written legal notice within 30 days of receiving return memo via registered post with A/D.

procedure_steps.title: Wait 30 Days for Payment
procedure_steps.desc: Allow 30 clear days for the drawer to pay the cheque amount from date of notice delivery.

procedure_steps.title: File C.R. Case in Court
procedure_steps.desc: If drawer fails to pay, file complaint (CR Case) before CMM / CJM Court within the next 30 days.

procedure_steps.title: Trial & Judgment
procedure_steps.desc: Case transferred to Sessions Court. Court can award double the cheque amount and imprisonment up to 1 year.

laws.penalties: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to twice the amount of the dishonoured cheque, or both. Fine collected is awarded directly to the complainant.
laws.penalties_bn: ১ বছর পর্যন্ত কারাদণ্ড অথবা চেকে উল্লেখিত অর্থের দ্বিগুণ পর্যন্ত জরিমানা অথবা উভয় দণ্ড। জরিমানার সমুদয় অর্থ মামলার বাদীকে প্রদানের নির্দেশ দেওয়া হয়।
required_documents: Original dishonoured cheque and bank deposit slip
Original Bank Cheque Return Memo with seal and signature
Copy of Legal Notice served by Advocate
Postal receipt and Acknowledgment Due (A/D) card or courier delivery confirmation
immediate_actions: Track dates meticulously; calculate deadlines in a calendar immediately upon receiving bank return memo.
Always send notice to both present and permanent addresses of the cheque drawer via registered post with A/D.
Retain clear photocopies of the front and back of the original cheque.

laws.title: Divorce, Dower (Denmohur) & Maintenance
laws.bangla_title: তালাক, দেনমোহর এবং ভরণপোষণ সংক্রান্ত আইন
laws.act_no_year: Ordinance VIII of 1961 & Act VII of 2023
acts: Family Courts Act, 2023 / Family Court Ordinance, 1985
laws.simple_summary: Under Bangladeshi law, both husband and wife have defined rights regarding marriage dissolution. When a husband pronounces Talaq, he must send written notice to the local Union Parishad Chairman / City Mayor and a copy to the wife. A 90-day reconciliation period is mandatory before divorce becomes effective. The wife is legally entitled to her full remaining Dower (Denmohur) and maintenance (Khorposh) during the Iddat period. Denmohur cannot be waived forcibly under any circumstance.
laws.simple_summary_bn: বাংলাদেশে মুসলিম পারিবারিক আইন অনুযায়ী স্বামী বা স্ত্রী উভয়েরই বিবাহ বিচ্ছেদের নির্ধারিত আইনগত অধিকার রয়েছে। স্বামী তালাক দিলে স্থানীয় ইউনিয়ন পরিষদ চেয়ারম্যান বা সিটি মেয়রের কাছে লিখিত নোটিশ পাঠাতে হবে এবং তার অনুলিপি স্ত্রীকে পাঠাতে হবে। নোটিশ প্রেরণের ৯০ দিন পর তালাক কার্যকর হয়। স্ত্রী তার সম্পূর্ণ দেনমোহর এবং ইদ্দতকালীন ভরণপোষণ পাওয়ার পূর্ণ আইনগত অধিকারী।
key_provisions: Written notice to Union Parishad / City Corporation Arbitration Council is compulsory under Section 7.
Arbitration council tries reconciliation within 30 days of receiving notice.
If not reconciled, Talaq becomes legally effective after 90 days from notice date.
Prompt Dower must be paid on demand; Deferred Dower is mandatory upon dissolution of marriage.
Failure to send official notice carries punishment of imprisonment up to 1 year or a fine up to ৳10,000.

procedure_steps.title: Send Written Notice
procedure_steps.desc: Send registered post notice to local Chairman/Mayor and a copy to the spouse via registered post with A/D.

procedure_steps.title: Arbitration Council Notice
procedure_steps.desc: Arbitration Council issues notice to both parties to attend reconciliation meetings.

procedure_steps.title: 90-Day Waiting Period
procedure_steps.desc: Divorce takes legal effect after 90 days from date Chairman received the notice.

procedure_steps.title: File Suit for Dower/Maintenance
procedure_steps.desc: If Denmohur or maintenance is withheld, file a suit in the Family Court (court fee is minimal: ৳25-50).

procedure_steps.title: Decree & Execution
procedure_steps.desc: Family Court issues decree for payment; non-compliance may lead to civil detention of the defaulter.

laws.penalties: Non-compliance with Section 7 notice: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine up to ৳10,000. Willful default on Family Court maintenance decree results in civil jail until compliance.
laws.penalties_bn: তালাকের লিখিত নোটিশ না দিলে ১ বছর পর্যন্ত কারাদণ্ড বা ১০,০০০ টাকা পর্যন্ত অর্থদণ্ড। দেনমোহর বা ভরণপোষণ পরিশোধ না করলে পারিবারিক আদালতের নির্দেশে দেওয়ানি জেলে আটক রাখার বিধান।
required_documents: Original Nikahnama (Kabinnama) / Marriage Registration Certificate
National ID (NID) copy of applicant
Postal receipts of Talaq notices sent via registered post
Bank statements or proof of income of husband for maintenance calculation
Birth certificates of children (if custody/maintenance involved)
immediate_actions: Collect certified copy of Nikahnama from the Kazi office where registered.
Always send notices via registered post with Acknowledgment Due (A/D) to maintain proof of delivery.
Do not sign any blank stamps or compromise deed without lawyer verification.

laws.title: Cyber Harassment, Online Fraud & Digital Safety
laws.bangla_title: অনলাইন প্রতারণা, সাইবার হেনস্তা ও সাইবার নিরাপত্তা আইন
laws.simple_summary: Cybercrime includes hacking accounts, identity theft, spreading manipulated intimate photos/blackmail, phishing scams, and financial fraud through mobile banking apps. Bangladesh law strictly prohibits publishing indecent or defaming materials electronically and committing fraud via computer devices. Victims can seek immediate intervention through Thana, Cyber Crime Investigation Division (CID), and National Cyber Security Agency.
laws.simple_summary_bn: অনলাইনে একাউন্ট হ্যাকিং, ব্ল্যাকমেইল, আপত্তিকর ছবি ছড়িয়ে দেওয়ার হুমকি, মোবাইল ব্যাংকিং প্রতারণা এবং ভুয়া পরিচয় দিয়ে প্রতারণা সাইবার নিরাপত্তা আইনের অধীনে কঠোর দণ্ডনীয় অপরাধ। ভুক্তভোগীরা নিকটস্থ থানা, সিআইডি সাইবার পুলিশ এবং বিটিআরসির মাধ্যমে দ্রুত প্রতিকার পেতে পারেন।
key_provisions: Identity theft and impersonation: Operating fake profile to defraud is a punishable offence.
Blackmail with intimate pictures: Offence under CSA and Pornography Control Act 2012 carries severe imprisonment.
Financial fraud (bKash/Nagad scams): Investigated jointly under Cyber Security Act and Penal Code 420.
Cyber Police Centre hotline (01320010148) provides 24/7 technical and emergency assistance.

procedure_steps.title: Preserve Digital Evidence
procedure_steps.desc: Capture unedited full-screen screenshots showing profile URLs, timestamps, message headers, and transaction IDs.

procedure_steps.title: Report to Cyber Crime Helpdesk
procedure_steps.desc: Contact Police Cyber Support for Women (PCSW) or CID Cyber Centre via hotline/Facebook page.

procedure_steps.title: File GD / FIR at Thana
procedure_steps.desc: Lodge formal GD or FIR at nearest police station with printed screenshots and digital media on pen drive.

procedure_steps.title: BTRC URL Blocking Request
procedure_steps.desc: Investigating officer or victim petitions Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission (BTRC) to take down offensive links.

procedure_steps.title: Cyber Tribunal Trial
procedure_steps.desc: Case tried before the designated Cyber Tribunal in Dhaka / Divisional headquarters.

laws.penalties: Rigorous imprisonment up to 5 years and fine up to ৳25 Lakh for identity theft, hacking, and online extortion. Under Pornography Control Act: Up to 10 years rigorous imprisonment.
laws.penalties_bn: হ্যাকিং ও সাইবার প্রতারণায় ৫ বছর পর্যন্ত কারাদণ্ড ও ২৫ লাখ টাকা পর্যন্ত জরিমানা। পর্নোগ্রাফি নিয়ন্ত্রণ আইনে ১০ বছর পর্যন্ত সশ্রম কারাদণ্ড ও ৫ লাখ টাকা অর্থদণ্ডের বিধান।
required_documents: High-resolution screenshots with visible URLs, phone numbers, and timestamps
Transaction IDs / MFS statements (bKash/Nagad/Rocket) for financial scams
Audio call recordings or screen recordings of extortion calls
Link of fake profile / group / channel
immediate_actions: Do not delete chats or block offender before taking screenshots with complete URL links.
Never send ransom money via bKash; report immediately to Police Cyber Support.
Immediately activate Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) on all email and social accounts.

laws.title: Bail Laws & Criminal Defense (Anticipatory & Regular Bail)
laws.bangla_title: জামিন আইন ও ফৌজদারি প্রতিরক্ষা (আগাম ও নিয়মিত জামিন)
acts: The High Court Rules (Anticipatory Bail Guidelines)
laws.simple_summary: In Bangladesh, offences are divided into Bailable and Non-Bailable. In bailable offences (Sec 496), bail is a matter of right. In non-bailable offences (Sec 497), granting bail is the court’s discretion, considering health, age, nature of accusation, and risk of absconding. Anticipatory Bail (আগাম জামিন under Sec 498) is sought before arrest directly from the High Court Division to prevent unlawful harassment.
laws.simple_summary_bn: ফৌজদারি কার্যবিধি অনুযায়ী জামিনযোগ্য অপরাধে জামিন পাওয়া নাগরিকের অধিকার। জামিন-অযোগ্য অপরাধে জামিন প্রদান আদালতের সুবিবেচনাধীন। তবে কোনো ব্যক্তি যদি কোনো মামলায় অন্যায়ভাবে গ্রেফতার বা হয়রানির আশঙ্কা করেন, তবে গ্রেফতার এড়াতে হাইকোর্ট বিভাগে উপস্থিত হয়ে আগাম জামিন (Anticipatory Bail) প্রার্থনা করতে পারেন।
key_provisions: Bailable offence: Police or Magistrate is legally bound to grant bail upon furnishing bail bond.
Non-bailable offence: Bail can be granted by Magistrate or Sessions Court if grounds are satisfied.
Anticipatory bail: Only High Court Division can grant anticipatory bail for a limited period (typically 4-8 weeks) directing surrender to Sessions Court.
Sick, infirm, minor, or female accused persons enjoy special leniency under proviso to Section 497(1).

procedure_steps.title: Ascertain Case Number & FIR
procedure_steps.desc: Obtain certified copy of FIR / GD / CR case petition and seizure list from court.

procedure_steps.title: Draft Bail Application
procedure_steps.desc: Lawyer prepares grounds of bail highlighting innocence, lack of overt act, and roots in society.

procedure_steps.title: Hearing before Magistrate / Sessions Judge
procedure_steps.desc: Advocate argues the bail petition. If rejected, move criminal miscellaneous petition to Sessions Court.

procedure_steps.title: High Court Appeal / Motion
procedure_steps.desc: If Sessions Court denies bail, file criminal miscellaneous petition under Section 498 CrPC in High Court Division.

procedure_steps.title: Furnish Bail Bond & Release
procedure_steps.desc: Submit bail bond with local sureties. Court issues release order (খালাস পরোয়ানা) to Central Jail.

laws.penalties: Violating bail conditions or absconding results in bail cancellation, forfeiture of surety bond, and issuance of Non-Bailable Arrest Warrant (WA).
laws.penalties_bn: জামিনের শর্ত ভঙ্গ করলে জামিন বাতিল, বন্ডের টাকা বাজেয়াপ্ত এবং গ্রেফতারি পরোয়ানা জারি করা হয়।
required_documents: Certified copy of FIR / Complaint petition
Certified copy of rejection order of lower court (if moving higher court)
Medical certificates (if applying on medical grounds)
National ID cards and land documents of local bailors (sureties)
immediate_actions: Do not evade police without legal counsel; contact an Advocate immediately to prepare anticipatory bail if apprehending arrest.
Ensure reliable local sureties (bailors) with valid NID and tax/utility documents are ready.

laws.title: Domestic Violence, Protection Orders & Dowry Prohibition
laws.bangla_title: পারিবারিক সহিংসতা প্রতিরোধ, সুরক্ষা আদেশ ও যৌতুক নিরোধ আইন
acts: Nari O Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000 (Amended 2020)
laws.simple_summary: The law protects women and children from physical, psychological, sexual, and economic abuse within domestic relationships. Victims can obtain emergency "Protection Orders", "Residence Orders" (right to stay in shared household without expulsion), and monetary compensation from the Judicial Magistrate Court. Demanding dowry in connection with marriage is also a severe criminal offence.
laws.simple_summary_bn: পারিবারিক সম্পর্কের মধ্যে যেকোনো ধরণের শারীরিক, মানসিক, যৌন ও অর্থনৈতিক নির্যাতন থেকে নারী ও শিশুদের সুরক্ষার জন্য আইনটি প্রণীত। ভুক্তভোগী নারী ম্যাজিস্ট্রেট আদালত থেকে জরুরি সুরক্ষা আদেশ এবং যৌথ পরিবারে বসবাসের অধিকার নিশ্চিত করতে পারেন। এছাড়াও যৌতুক দাবি করা জামিন-অযোগ্য অপরাধ।
key_provisions: Definition of domestic violence includes mental torture, verbal abuse, economic deprivation, and physical hurt.
Protection Orders: Magistrate can restrain the perpetrator from entering victim’s workplace or residence.
Residence Order: Prohibits the respondent from evicting the victim from the shared household.
Dowry Prohibition Act 2018: Demanding or giving dowry is punishable with up to 5 years imprisonment.
Emergency helpline 109 (National Helpline for Violence Against Women and Children) provides immediate shelter and legal aid.

procedure_steps.title: Medical Examination & Treatment
procedure_steps.desc: If physically injured, immediately visit One-Stop Crisis Centre (OCC) at Dhaka Medical College or government hospital for certified medical report.

procedure_steps.title: Application to Magistrate Court
procedure_steps.desc: File application under Section 11 of the 2010 Act directly or through Protection Officer/NGO for interim protection order.

procedure_steps.title: Passage of Interim Protection Order
procedure_steps.desc: Court passes emergency order within 24-48 hours prohibiting perpetrator from approaching victim.

procedure_steps.title: Filing Police Case / OCC Report
procedure_steps.desc: For heinous offences, lodge case under Nari O Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain at Thana.

procedure_steps.title: Monetary Compensation & Residence
procedure_steps.desc: Court awards monthly maintenance, medical reimbursement, and safe residence in final order.

laws.penalties: Breach of Protection Order: Imprisonment up to 6 months or fine up to ৳10,000 for first offence; up to 2 years imprisonment for repeated breach. Demanding Dowry: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine.
laws.penalties_bn: আদালতের সুরক্ষা আদেশ লঙ্ঘন করলে ৬ মাস থেকে ২ বছর পর্যন্ত কারাদণ্ড। যৌতুক দাবির দায়ে সর্বোচ্চ ৫ বছরের কারাদণ্ড ও অর্থদণ্ড।
required_documents: Medical injury certificate (OCC / Government Hospital discharge summary)
Marriage certificate (Nikahnama) and NID copy
Photographs of physical injuries / damaged property
Witness statements / audio recordings / abusive text messages
immediate_actions: Call emergency hotline 109 or 999 for instant police dispatch and rescue.
Go to the nearest government hospital One-Stop Crisis Centre (OCC) for medical evidence preservation.
National Legal Aid (16430) provides free lawyers and financial litigation support.

laws.title: Labour Law, Wrongful Termination & Wage Dues
laws.bangla_title: শ্রম আইন, বেআইনি বরখাস্ত ও বকেয়া বেতন-ভাতা আদায়
laws.simple_summary: The Bangladesh Labour Act protects workers and employees across factories, commercial establishments, and shops. It governs appointment letters, probation, regular payment of wages, maternity benefits, overtime rates (double normal wage), gratuity, provident fund, and strict procedures for termination or retrenchment. Termination without statutory notice or compensation can be challenged directly in the Labour Court.
laws.simple_summary_bn: বাংলাদেশ শ্রম আইন অনুযায়ী সকল স্থায়ী শ্রমিকের লিখিত নিয়োগপত্র ও পরিচয়পত্র বাধ্যতামূলক। বেতন পরিশোধ, অতিরিক্ত কাজের দ্বিগুণ মজুরি, ১৬ সপ্তাহের প্রসূতি কল্যাণ সুবিধা এবং বেআইনি বরখাস্তের ক্ষতিপূরণ নিশ্চিত করা হয়েছে। কোনো শ্রমিককে অন্যায়ভাবে ছাঁটাই করলে ৩৩ ধারার অধীন ৩০ দিনের মধ্যে মালিক বরাবর দাবি জানিয়ে শ্রম আদালতে মামলা করা যায়।
key_provisions: Mandatory written appointment letter and service book for all employees.
Wages must be paid within 7 working days following the wage period.
Termination by employer requires 120 days notice or pay in lieu for permanent workers, plus compensation of 30 days wages for every completed year of service.
Maternity leave of 16 weeks with full wages is mandatory for female employees.
Grievance procedure under Section 33: Worker must submit written grievance to employer within 30 days.

procedure_steps.title: Submit Grievance to Employer
procedure_steps.desc: Submit written grievance to employer within 30 days of the occurrence via registered post.

procedure_steps.title: Wait for Employer Response
procedure_steps.desc: Employer has 30 days to hold enquiry and communicate decision.

procedure_steps.title: File Complaint in Labour Court
procedure_steps.desc: If employer fails to respond or worker is dissatisfied, file complaint before the Chairman, Labour Court within next 30 days.

procedure_steps.title: Conciliation & Summary Trial
procedure_steps.desc: Labour Court conducts trial; worker does not need to pay heavy court fees.

procedure_steps.title: Appeal to Labour Appellate Tribunal
procedure_steps.desc: Any party aggrieved by Labour Court order can appeal within 60 days to Labour Appellate Tribunal.

laws.penalties: Employers violating labour provisions face criminal prosecution, fines up to ৳25,000, and recovery of worker dues as public demand with interest.
laws.penalties_bn: শ্রমিকদের আইনানুগ পাওনা পরিশোধ না করলে বা নিয়মবহির্ভূত বরখাস্ত করলে ২৫,০০০ টাকা পর্যন্ত জরিমানা ও শ্রম আদালতের নির্দেশে বকেয়া অর্থ আদায়।
required_documents: Appointment letter, ID card, and salary slips
Bank statement showing salary credits or attendance card
Termination/dismissal letter or email
Copy of written grievance sent to employer and postal receipt
immediate_actions: Never leave employment without collecting written experience certificate and clearance document.
Submit written grievance within exactly 30 days to preserve right to sue in Labour Court.

dictionary.definition: The initial written information recorded by police when a cognizable crime (murder, theft, rape, robbery) has been committed, triggering formal police investigation and arrest power without warrant.
A daily police register kept at every Thana. Citizens file a GD for preventive safety, lost documents (NID, passport, bank check), or threats of future injury.
Pre-arrest bail granted exclusively by the High Court Division when a citizen reasonably apprehends unlawful or politically motivated arrest in a non-bailable case before being physically detained.
The legal administrative process of recording a new buyer or heir’s name in the government land revenue records (Khatian) at the Upazila AC Land office, replacing the seller’s name.
A mandatory sum of money or property pledged by the husband to the wife in the Nikahnama. Prompt dower must be paid upon demand; deferred dower becomes mandatory upon dissolution of marriage.

A judicial restraining order prohibiting a party from altering, selling, constructing upon, or destroying a disputed property pending the final judgment of the court.
A constitutional writ petition to the High Court Division demanding that an illegally detained or abducted person be brought before the court to verify the legality of detention.

checklists.title: Statutory Legal Notice under Section 138 NI Act
checklists.description: Complete legal notice draft required within 30 days of receiving Cheque Return Memo from the bank.
checklists.content:
LEGAL NOTICE UNDER SECTION 138 OF THE NEGOTIABLE INSTRUMENTS ACT, 1881

To:
[Drawer Full Name]
Son/Daughter of: [Father Name]
Address: [Present & Permanent Address]

Under instructions and on behalf of my client [Complainant Name], residing at [Address], I hereby serve upon you this Statutory Legal Notice:

1. That in discharge of your legally enforceable debt, you issued a Cheque bearing No: [Cheque Number], dated [Date], for an amount of BDT [Amount in Figures] (Taka [Amount in Words]) drawn on [Bank Name], [Branch Name].
2. That my client presented the said cheque for encashment, but the same was dishonoured and returned unpaid by the bank with the memo dated [Return Memo Date] for the reason: "INSUFFICIENT FUNDS".
3. That by this notice, you are hereby requested to pay the full amount of BDT [Amount] to my client within 30 (thirty) days from the date of receipt of this notice, failing which my client will institute criminal proceedings against you under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 before the competent Court of Law.

Advocate, Supreme Court of Bangladesh / Judge Court

checklists.title: General Diary (GD) Application for Lost Documents / Threats
checklists.bangla_title: থানায় সাধারণ ডায়েরি (জিডি) করার আবেদন ফরম

checklists.bangla_title: শ্রম আইনের ৩৩ ধারায় মালিক বরাবর অভিযোগনামা
checklists.description: Mandatory written notice to the employer within 30 days of wrongful termination or unpaid wages.
checklists.content:
FORMAL GRIEVANCE NOTICE UNDER SECTION 33 OF THE BANGLADESH LABOUR ACT, 2006

Date: [Date]
To:
The Managing Director / Head of HR
[Company Name]
[Address]

Subject: Grievance under Section 33 of the Bangladesh Labour Act 2006 regarding [Unpaid Wages / Illegal Termination].

Dear Sir,
I, [Employee Name], designated as [Designation], ID No: [Employee ID], joined your establishment on [Joining Date].

1. On [Date], my employment was terminated abruptly without complying with Section 26 or 27 of the Labour Act.
2. My earned salary for [Months] and statutory severance dues totaling BDT [Amount] remain unpaid.

In accordance with Section 33(1) of the Bangladesh Labour Act 2006, I hereby submit this grievance and request you to settle my lawful dues within 30 days, failing which I shall be compelled to seek redress before the learned Chairman, Labour Court.

Sincerely,
[Employee Signature]
